## What changed

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the commands and physical Stream Deck models used to validate the change.

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] CGO-disabled target builds, when platform code changed
- [ ] Physical hardware validation, when protocol behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation and examples updated for public API changes

## Hardware details

For protocol changes, include the model, USB product ID, firmware version, and
which behavior was observed on the device. Remove serial numbers and other
private data from logs.
